what: No reference names the host API for the per-core CB budget. The natural pick, ttnn.get_max_worker_l1_unreserved_size(), measures from the kernel-config ring buffer, not the allocator base where CBs start, and overshoots the CB region by ~69 KB on BH (1531776 vs 1461120 B). It also ignores L1-resident tensors. The implementer used it, and shapes at the fit boundary (e.g. 1x1x544x11008 bf16) OOMed at runtime; neither the golden suite nor the acceptance tests caught it.
suggest: State in l1-footprint-discipline.md and /memory-budget-metal: CB budget = free L1 below the lowest allocated L1 buffer, from ttnn.get_memory_view(device, ttnn.BufferType.L1) (block_table / total_bytes_per_bank); never get_max_worker_l1_unreserved_size(). Add a fit-boundary shape to planner acceptance tests.
